source_text: Systematic reviews confirm no adverse impacts on sexual function, sensitivity, or satisfaction from circumcision, countering claims of foreskin-specific erogenous loss, as glans keratinization does not demonstrably impair overall penile sensation in controlled studies. [38] [161]
